title: 6 KiwiCo Alternatives for Kids Who Like to Build
summary: Six boxes like KiwiCo’s Kiwi Crate and Tinker Crate, compared on ages, contents, price basis, and video. Four from Cratejoy sellers, two direct from the brands.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to KiwiCo?


It depends on the line. For Kiwi Crate’s science-and-art month with a booklet, Green Kid Crafts Discovery Box is the closest on contents and age band. For Tinker Crate’s how-things-work projects, STEM Discovery Boxes is closest on contents, and CrunchLabs Build Box is closest on format if the single engineered toy is what your kid wants.


Which option costs less on comparable terms?


Kitsville’s $20 per box month to month is the lowest advertised box price here, before shipping and checkout fees. KiwiCo’s only advertised figure is “starting at $24,” with no billing term attached, so check kiwico.com for its monthly rate before you compare like with like. On 12-month prepaid terms the per-box prices are Kitsville $14, Little Passports $25 with free shipping in the contiguous U.S., CrunchLabs $27.45 paid annually with free U.S. shipping, STEM Discovery Boxes $30, Green Kid Crafts $31.95 with free U.S. shipping per the seller, and GIGIL $37.82 showing at $32.15 on sale. Three of the Cratejoy listings don’t state shipping, so this is a box-price list, not a delivered-cost comparison.


Can I send one of these as a gift?


All four Cratejoy listings show a Give as a Gift option next to For Myself. Cratejoy’s FAQ says “Gift orders are non-recurring” and “Some sellers let you pick a gift length.” Gift notes vary by seller, so check the listing. KiwiCo, CrunchLabs, and Little Passports each offer their own gift paths on their sites. Sellers ship marketplace orders on their own schedules, so we can’t promise an arrival date for any of them.


Which of these need a screen?


GIGIL streams its monthly lesson, and CrunchLabs unlocks a Mark Rober video per box, though CrunchLabs says the build itself does not need it. KiwiCo’s videos and activity ideas are online. Green Kid Crafts, STEM Discovery Boxes, Kitsville, and Little Passports don’t list a video component. Whether their printed instructions point to one online is not something the listings say.


Does this list cover every KiwiCo line?


No. It covers substitutes for Kiwi Crate (6–9) and Tinker Crate (9–12) only. Green Kid Crafts’ Junior Box (3–4) and GIGIL’s PreK–1st band reach younger, and this list does not offer substitutes for Panda, Koala, Atlas, Doodle, Maker, or Eureka.
